title: Interactive Discovery and Exploration of Visual Bias in Generative Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring image-text similarity using CLIP to compare generated images of gender anchor concepts ('woman' vs 'man') against various text-based test concepts, with secondary validation using the FairFace classifier.

Measuring image-text similarity using CLIP to compare generated images of racial anchor concepts ('Latino person' vs 'Caucasian person') against text-based test concepts, with secondary validation using the FairFace classifier.
Measuring image-text similarity using CLIP to compare generated images of geographic anchor concepts ('Germany' vs 'Nigeria') against test concepts related to environment, clothing, and architecture.
